stabpen.provenance.evidence_status: CALCULATION on PROPOSED DESIGNS (study N, round 4: the balanced nib's reach, force and heat); inputs from study K (revk/, results/revK/), study B (bnib/, results/bnib/), study F (results/readable/), the independent engineering pass (revk/feasibility.py, revk/improve.py, revk/compact.py, results/improvement/mechanics/), datasheets (MANUFACTURER) or ASSUMPTION; nothing built or measured
stabpen.provenance.parameters: every input with its label and source: results/nibopt/nibopt.json -> inputs (nibopt/params.py)

length_limits.label: CALCULATION (pooled feasible points, fill 0.55, body <= 24 mm)

F_n_N.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
F_n_N.source: face force along the paper normal: N = F_n at every tilt (study B config/nib.yaml; Rev K's constant-force float, revk/params.B1 F_n_N); frozen only after gate G1 (EXP-B20)

tilts_mean_deg.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
tilts_mean_deg.source: study B's four tilts for the mean over 35-75 deg (bnib/candidates.THETAS)

tilt_worst_deg.label: LITERATURE
tilt_worst_deg.source: CON-02 / REQ-RVH-002 lower end of the 35-75 deg range (largest gravity and couple)

rolls_n.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
rolls_n.source: roll sampled every 30 deg for the roll mean and the worst roll

residual_mean_mN.label: CALCULATION
residual_mean_mN.source: study K face-parallelism Monte Carlo (results/revK/revK.json face_parallelism_stack Q_mN.mean; contributors ASSUMPTION; EXP-B22 / EXP-B28)

residual_p95_mN.label: CALCULATION
residual_p95_mN.source: study K face-parallelism Monte Carlo, 95th percentile

contact_share.label: ASSUMPTION
contact_share.source: study B duty: ball on the paper 70 % of the writing time (review section 4)

writing_speed_m_s.label: LITERATURE
writing_speed_m_s.source: CON-20 (adult phrase writing on paper), study B duty A

ink.label: LITERATURE
ink.source: CON-13 friction of a common oil ballpoint (bnib/labels FRICTION)

slide_friction_N.label: ASSUMPTION
slide_friction_N.source: refill-in-carrier slide friction (Rev J value, study B h_sl; REQ-BNIB-016)

face_mu.label: ASSUMPTION
face_mu.source: rolling shoe on the sapphire face (study B CounterFace.mu_face; EXP-B22)

face_guide_N.label: ASSUMPTION
face_guide_N.source: friction of the face's guide (study B CounterFace.h_face; K's float is a flexure)

couple_lever_mm.label: CALCULATION
couple_lever_mm.source: ball to the face contact along the refill (study K nib.summary L_lever_mm = holder z0 65.8 + stem 2.0 mm; couple M = F_n L cos(theta) = 10.87 mN m at 35 deg)

weight_trim.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
weight_trim.source: matched baseline: the face is set parallel to the paper (study K's head), so the coils hold the moving mass's weight in contact as well; study B's duty model trimmed the face to cancel it in contact (bnib/balance.CounterFace comp_weight=True), which study K's budget inherited

A.label: ASSUMPTION
A.source: study B duty A: 0.2 mm rms per axis at 8 Hz, writing 30.5 mm/s in every direction, 70 % contact (bnib/candidates.DUTY_A)

modes_K.label: ASSUMPTION
modes_K.source: study K's REQ-RVJ-I01 modes (revk/budgets.modes; 8 Hz); steady_2mm is clipped at the reach

severe.label: SIMULATION
severe.source: study F (results/readable/readable.json reach.rows '*|a_r2'): the nib's 2-D rms travel in contact when perfect knowledge is scaled to leave DEC-067's +2-words residual (0.65 mm), by usable reach; centre 6 Hz from study R's severe classes (PD 6.3 Hz, ET 5.7 Hz; docs/real_data.md), line width 0.6 Hz (study R's frequency SD); magnitude spread fitted to the perfect-knowledge command's p50/p90/p99 (1.21 / 2.50 / 3.81 mm, rms 1.60 mm)

screen.label: CALCULATION
screen.source: the independent pass's worst-case periodic screen (revk/improve.matched_force_duty): full-radius sinusoids at 4, 8, 12 Hz in eight directions

screen_pass_loads_mN.label: ASSUMPTION
screen_pass_loads_mN.source: the pass's constant residual loads (its sensitivity inputs)

F_reach.label: SIMULATION
F_reach.source: study F reach check (docs/readable_target.md s8; tuning split, 20 severe cases, 5 writers, the Rev J nose with its travel cut): target DEC-067 0.55-0.65 mm

derating.label: ASSUMPTION
derating.source: DEC-041 / study B / the pass: image-method magnetics is an upper bound; 0.7 x is the stated derating (EXP-B23 / EXP-K22 measure K_m)

grades.label: MANUFACTURER
grades.source: AMF-139 (N52 1.42-1.48 T, 80 degC class), AMF-28 (N48SH class, 150 degC); low ends used

quad_fast.label: CALCULATION
quad_fast.source: filaments bundle x thickness x piece for the optimiser: within 0.1 % of the (8, 4, 32) reference on Rev K's coil (nibopt tests)

n_img_fast.label: CALCULATION
n_img_fast.source: image periods for the optimiser (0.04 % from 3 periods on Rev K's coil)

k_C17200_W_mK.label: MANUFACTURER
k_C17200_W_mK.source: Materion alloy 25 (the pass's value, quoted there; ASSUMPTION for 0.1 mm wire)

I_max_A.label: CALCULATION
I_max_A.source: study K: 3.3 V / (3.03 + 0.24) ohm with the C17200 leads

R_coil_K_ohm.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
R_coil_K_ohm.source: study B / K coil wound for 2.5 ohm per axis

wire_rise_limit_K.label: ASSUMPTION
wire_rise_limit_K.source: the pass's lead-heating screen (rise above the clamps, no convection)

coil_T_max_C.label: ASSUMPTION
coil_T_max_C.source: coil insulation limit with margin (study B T_coil_max 120 degC)

h_W_m2K.label: ASSUMPTION
h_W_m2K.source: natural convection + radiation (study K fin model, Rev J)

R_int_K_W.label: ASSUMPTION
R_int_K_W.source: coil to shell through the bonded stator (study K THERMAL R_int_coil_K_W)

R_carrier_mm.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
R_carrier_mm.source: Ti carrier tube 3.2 / 2.5 mm round the D1 refill (study B/K)

coil_p99_loss_mm.label: CALCULATION
coil_p99_loss_mm.source: study K tolerance Monte Carlo: the coil's 0.30 mm running clearance falls to 0.21 mm at the 99th percentile (revk/tolerance.mechanics, results/revK/revK.json tolerance)

clearance_p99_min_mm.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
clearance_p99_min_mm.source: brief: coil clearance >= 0.2 mm at the stop, 99th percentile

stop_margin_mm.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
stop_margin_mm.source: hard stop 0.2 mm beyond the usable radius (study B / the pass)

mode_ratio.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
mode_ratio.source: DEC-050: lowest structural mode >= 2.5 x the servo bandwidth, ball free and stuck

cycles.label: CALCULATION
cycles.source: study B FAT (8 Hz x 2 h/day x 250 days x 3 yr)

C17200.label: MANUFACTURER
C17200.source: AMF-19 (CDA C17200 TH04: E, fatigue 310 MPa at 1e8); UTS 1280 MPa as the pass (feasibility.wire_anchor)

fatigue_knockdown.label: ASSUMPTION
fatigue_knockdown.source: size/surface knock-down on thin wire (study B FAT size_surface)

Kt_worst.label: ASSUMPTION
Kt_worst.source: stress concentration at a soldered clamp or sleeve edge, worst corner (the pass, study B)

tol_corner.label: ASSUMPTION
tol_corner.source: the pass's worst fatigue corner (revk/improve.wire_design): diameter +2 %, length -0.05 mm, modulus +4 %, anchor stiffness +20 %, 5 mN assembly tension

strut_misfit_um.label: ASSUMPTION
strut_misfit_um.source: axial length misfit between struts after jigged soldering (an over-constrained plane for n > 3); EXP-NB04 measures it

hertz_C0_GPa.label: MANUFACTURER
hertz_C0_GPa.source: AMF-260 (MinebeaMitsumi: the basic static load rating is the load at which the contact stress at the centre of the most loaded ball-race contact is 4,200 MPa, a permanent deformation of about 0.0001 of the ball diameter; ISO 76's basis)

hertz_run_GPa.label: ASSUMPTION
hertz_run_GPa.source: sustained writing load: static safety factor s0 >= 2 for quiet running and high accuracy (AMF-261, NES after ISO 76), i.e. 4.2 GPa / 2^(1/3) = 3.33 GPa; applying the ball-bearing rule to 440C sphere-on-flat races is an ASSUMPTION (EXP-K20 / EXP-NB05)

hertz_static_GPa.label: ASSUMPTION
hertz_static_GPa.source: drop (the race springs' release load): s0 >= 1.5 for pronounced shock (AMF-261), 4.2 GPa / 1.5^(1/3) = 3.67 GPa; study K used 4 GPa

mu_roll.label: ASSUMPTION
mu_roll.source: rolling resistance of Si3N4 balls on lapped 440C (study K / the pass; EXP-K20)

preload_min_margin.label: PROPOSED DESIGN
preload_min_margin.source: race preload >= 1.2 x the preload at which the Hertz solver first unloads a ball under the 35 deg couple (covers F_n +20 %, REQ-BNIB-008)

holder_ext_g_per_mm.label: ASSUMPTION
holder_ext_g_per_mm.source: the pass's moving-mass charge for the refill-holder extension (revk/improve.matched_force_duty: 0.025e-3 kg per mm)

B_plate_T.label: ASSUMPTION
B_plate_T.source: working flux density in the back plate and keeper (1010 saturates near 1.6-1.7 T; Hiperco 50A 2.35 T, AMF-140), used to size the plate thickness

actuator_z0_mm.label: CALCULATION
actuator_z0_mm.source: study K back-plate front face (results/revK/layout.json back_plate z0)

actuator_stack_K_mm.label: CALCULATION
actuator_stack_K_mm.source: study K back plate 1.47 + magnets 3.5 + c0 0.3 + coils 1.6 + c1 0.15 + keeper 1.47 mm

guide_stack_K_mm.label: CALCULATION
guide_stack_K_mm.source: study K front race 0.3 + balls 0.8 + flange 1.5 + balls 0.8 + rear race 0.3 mm

shell_g_per_mm.label: CALCULATION
shell_g_per_mm.source: PEEK tube 24 / 22 mm (MANUFACTURER AMF-24 density 1.30 g/cc)

wiring_share.label: ASSUMPTION
wiring_share.source: +10 % wiring and adhesive (Rev J / K convention)

rows.topology: wires alone (study B / K's four 0.10 mm C17200 wires on a 5.5 mm circle)
rows.reason: 0.70 N of compression per wire against 34.4 mN fixed-fixed buckling (study K N14)

rows.topology: four wires pre-tensioned to 1.19 N each (circle 5.5 mm, 34.0 mm long)
rows.reason: tension stiffening n T / L: the spring force at the stop exceeds the moving mass's weight

rows.topology: four wires pre-tensioned to 0.72 N each (circle 9.0 mm, 40.0 mm long)
rows.reason: tension stiffening n T / L: the spring force at the stop exceeds the moving mass's weight

rows.topology: necked struts (stiff middle, short C17200 hinges) in place of wires and balls
rows.reason: a hinge short enough to carry the couple's compression twice over bends to Goodman 1.04 at the stop (target 1.5)

rows.topology: two planar flexure stages (beams 15 x taller than wide, 5 N/m lateral each, 20 mm apart)
rows.reason: tilt 149 mrad under the couple (5.4 mm at the ball): the out-of-plane to in-plane stiffness ratio of a planar beam is only (height / width)^2

rows.topology: nested parallel-blade XY stage (two blades per axis, 16 mm apart)

best.label: CALCULATION (fixed-guided blades; C17200 AMF-19; Kt 1.3 etched fillet ASSUMPTION)

rows.reason: carries the couple, but its lateral spring force at the stop is several times the wires' and it needs two stages in series (about 35-60 mm)

rows.topology: ball thrust guide, 2 x 6 Si3N4 0.8 mm on 16.6 mm, 4 N preload per race + wires
rows.reason: rolling drag mu_roll x total normal load, Coulomb

rows.topology: ball thrust guide, 2 x 6 Si3N4 0.8 mm on 16.6 mm, 1 N preload per race + wires
rows.reason: rolling drag mu_roll x total normal load, Coulomb

screen_topologies.label: CALCULATION (beam models; C17200 AMF-19; tolerances and Kt ASSUMPTION)
